Quirenote · design extension · brief #572 · implementing #573 and #574

Account deletion: the step on /profile, the window and its gate

Brief: #572, as a comment on the issue, and its amendments. Implementing tasks: #573 (the deletion core, the route and the grant) and #574 (the /profile slice). Every frame is the running app, its own DOM re-worded where deletion speaks, serialized from computed styles, so a value here is a value the app already renders.

T1 · The place on /profile, and the refusal

A fifth card, «Видалення», last on the page (session step 1, A). It is the Sessions card’s own anatomy: the 10 px microlabel, then a SettingRow with its title and helper, and the trigger beside it at ≥ md and under it below. The trigger is outlineDanger, «Видалити обліковий запис…»; the filled danger belongs to the confirmation (button-variants.ts: “The outline trigger opens a confirm; the fill is the dialog's armed action”). The only super-admin sees the same row with the refusal in the helper’s place, in muted, and no trigger: refused before any press (GitLab renders no delete button for a sole owner). The demo identity is not drawn: no token can carry its sub (authorize.ts), so it never reaches /profile. Held, while GET /me is out, the trigger is a panel block of its size, as every link and button on the page is held. The card stands after «Вхід», whose passkey list is a read of its own, so when that list lands after the account the card moves by the list’s change (T8). own-account.dc.html T1 put «Вхід» last for that reason (web.dev, Optimize CLS: “placing it later on the page”); the owner ruled the shift accepted, a press in it only opening the confirmation.

T2 · The confirmation

The top-anchored AlertDialog that #496 set up, 64 from the top at ≥ md and 16 below, the dialog’s own type (18 / 24 title, 12 / 18 muted body). The body names what goes, the backups’ 35 days, and where the copy is, as a link (NewTabLink: accent, underlined, a new tab, so the dialog and what was typed stay). Under it, what each button means, in the buttons’ order. Then the typed address (danger.typeToConfirm, the field DangerZone draws), focused on opening. The timing is the button pressed (session step 2, C): the danger «Видалити одразу», the outlineDanger «Видалити через 30 днів», and «Скасувати», stacked at every width, since three labels pass the panel’s content box side by side. Both stay at the gated 50 % until the address matches, case and the edges’ spaces ignored. Nothing is chosen in advance. No «Спершу завантажте копію» button: the owner ruled the link in the text enough.

T3 · The re-authentication, with deletion’s lines

re-authentication.dc.html’s step, every state of it, unredrawn; only its host’s lines change. Either button of T2 swaps the content to the first state, its lead deletion’s. A passkey or the password runs the action at once (#496); back from Google, the confirmed state names the action for the timing pressed and waits for one press, the time left showing. The confirmed action keeps the step’s own filled primary: the irreversible choice was made, in danger, in T2. The slot’s widget is lifted from that sheet, Cloudflare’s iframe drawing nothing in a capture.

T4 · In progress, failed, asked again

In progress, the filled button reads «Видаляємо…» and both buttons take the busy tone (70 %); Escape is ignored (#496 amendment 4). A failure lands on the confirmed state with its sentence 12 under the row and the time left above it; one press asks again and goes on from where it stopped (the owner’s ruling: no marker). Closed after a failure, /profile is as it stands, and the same trigger asks again. With the 30-day timing the lines are «Плануємо видалення…» and «Не вдалося запланувати видалення. Спробуйте ще раз.» in the same places (T10). Any failure of the deletion, a lost connection included, is that one sentence, as the shipped step’s action failure always is (actionFailed, SignOutEverywhere.tsx). On the passkey step, which has no filled button, the busy line stands in the step’s status line (#496 amendment 2). That is the step’s own state, drawn in re-authentication.dc.html, with deletion’s words (T10).

T5 · The landing

/sign-in’s address step, with sign-out-landing.dc.html’s line carrying the deletion’s sentence: role="status", focus unmoved, used up on arrival as the sign-out’s is. A sentence that wraps pushes the title down by its own height and moves nothing else. The app mails nothing of its own, so this sentence is the user’s notice of the deletion; the scheduled one names its date. The sign-in widget is lifted from bot-check.dc.html (address, verifying).

T6 · The window’s gate

A sign-in by the end of the date reaches AnswerScreen, a sixth answer, scheduled, in place of every page, so nothing of the portfolio shows behind it. It is the one answer that carries data: its lead takes the date the API’s refusal names (#574’s mechanism; the five shipped answers read a plain title and lead from t.auth[answer]). Lucide’s calendar-clock in muted, the title, the lead with the date, «Ви увійшли як …», the filled «Скасувати видалення» and the outline «Вийти». Signing in alone cancels nothing (the owner’s ruling). Cancelling takes no re-authentication beyond the sign-in that reached the gate; which sign-ins may cancel, and what a sign-in meets once the date has ended, are #573’s (amendment 4). Cancelling is a way out that is not a sign-out, as the terms step’s «Прийняти умови» already is. Busy takes the busy tone; a failure is StepAlert’s sentence 12 under the row; «Вийти» is the plain sign-out landing.

T7 · Cancelled

The page asked for — / after a fresh sign-in, /profile as drawn here — and the app’s success toast «Видалення скасовано» (session step 3, A), once, as «Стерти дані» says «Дані стерто» (DangerZone.tsx, toast.success), with no full stop, as the shipped success toasts have none. The toast is the success idiom only; a refusal never takes one (#496).

One empty box does: sonner’s toaster list in T7 at 360, 0 high and unpainted, 12 to 372 as it stands in the app, which it does not widen there (it is fixed). Every drawn box was held against the running app’s own (5216 boxes, the worst off by 0,01 px). T10 · Copy

Ukrainian by default. {date} is dd.MM.yyyy: the last day the deletion can be cancelled, the 30th day counting the Kyiv day after the press as the first (Civil Code art. 253: «Перебіг строку починається з наступного дня…»; art. 255: an act «може бути вчинена до закінчення останнього дня строку»; no roll past a weekend or holiday, the owner’s ruling, the cancel being online every day). A press on 30.10.2026 gives 29.11.2026, and the deletion runs as that day ends in Kyiv. The landing and the gate show the date the server stores; {address} is the account’s own and is data, not copy, so no translation can make the buttons unarmable. A link in the body is rich()’s [label](href). Shipped lines are read from src/i18n/messages.ts.

T11 · Refused, and not drawn

  • Refused: a window with no immediate option, and immediate with no window; a timing chosen in advance; radios or option blocks for the timing (session step 2, A and B); a separate page for the confirmation; a «Спершу завантажте копію» button (the owner: the link in the text is enough); a fixed typed word; signing in as the cancel; a window in which the app stays usable; the super-admin offered a trigger and refused after the press; a marker for a deletion that stopped part way; a confirming card after a cancel (step 3, C); a toast for a refusal; a mailed receipt or a reminder before the purge.
  • Not drawn: the demo identity, which never reaches /profile; the busy line in the passkey step’s status line, the step’s own state in re-authentication.dc.html with deletion’s words (T4, T10); the re-authentication step’s other states and the signed-out landing’s geometry, which are their sheets’ and reused; the English frames, the copy being in T10; a super-admin deleting another account (#535, #541); /privacy and /terms, which still send a deletion to support@, and the support@ correspondence /privacy promises to delete with the account: #575.
